hero.oneLiner: The deck positions Edelweiss Financial Services as a diversified financial services holding company with seven high-quality operating businesses - alternative asset management, mutual fund, asset reconstruction, NBFC, housing finance, general insurance and life insurance - now shifting weight toward capital-light asset management while winding down legacy wholesale credit and preparing to unlock value through the EAAA listing and the Carlyle investment in Nido.

business_model.title: Positioning (investor deck)
business_model.body:
- Described as 'Diversified with seven high-quality businesses' held under Edelweiss Financial Services Ltd (EFSL): EAAA India Alternatives (Alternative Asset Mgt), Edelweiss Asset Management (Mutual Fund), Edelweiss Asset Reconstruction (EARC), ECL Finance (NBFC), Nido Home Finance (Housing Finance), Zuno General Insurance and Edelweiss Life Insurance.
- EFSL stakes stated per entity: EAAA 96%, EAML 85%, EARC 84%, ECLF 100%, NHFL 100%, ZGIL 100%, ELI 83%.
- Total customer reach increased to 14 Mn, up 30% YoY, with customer assets at INR 2.8 Tn, up 23% YoY.
- Positioned on two structural claims: 'Robust growth in consol PAT and key metrics of operating businesses' and 'Resilient balance sheet with well-capitalised businesses'.
- EAAA claims a full exit from EIYP, 'marking one of the first successful infrastructure yield fund exits by an Indian manager'.

capital_allocation.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)
capital_allocation.body:
- Corporate net debt declined by 10% YoY to INR 5,725 Cr; net debt across businesses totals INR 11,160 Cr (Housing Finance 2,075, NBFC 1,955, Asset Reconstruction 1,185, Alternative Asset Management 220, Corporate 5,725).
- BVPS at INR 57 (FV INR 1), up 19% YoY.
- Capital ratios stated as well-capitalised: NBFC capital adequacy 27%, Housing Finance 30%, Asset Reconstruction 36%, General Insurance solvency 164%, Life Insurance solvency 189%.
- Surplus liquidity cover maintained for Jul 26 to Jun 27: opening available liquidity INR 6,100 Cr, total inflows INR 11,900 Cr (expected inflows 8,900 plus fresh borrowings 3,000), total outflows INR 12,300 Cr (repayments 7,600 plus disbursements 4,700), closing available liquidity INR 5,700 Cr.
- Deck discusses no dividend or buyback policy.

other.title: Notable from the deck
other.body:
- [Wholesale wind-down] The ECLF wholesale book was successfully wound down to INR 600 Cr in Jun 26 from a peak of INR 18,000 Cr in Mar 19, described as 'down to near zero from a peak of INR 18,000 Cr'.
- [Stake sale] Carlyle's investment in Nido (Home Finance) is progressing with closure expected in September 2026 - a third-party capital event in a 100%-owned subsidiary.
- [Value unlock] EAAA India Alternatives is planned for listing in Q3 FY27; the deck directs readers to a separate detailed business update of EAAA India Alternatives.
- [Restatement] NBFC AUM, gross loan book, GNPA, NNPA and financials for the quarter ended Jun 25 have been restated on account of the merger between ECLF and ERFL.
- [Definitions] The deck's own safe harbour flags that business-wise financials, balance sheet and AUM are reclassified/regrouped on management estimates and may not directly correspond to published data; net debt is gross debt minus high quality liquid assets and excludes CBLO and securitisation liabilities; customer reach includes MF folios, individuals covered under Group Insurance policies for LI and customers serviced since inception for GI.
